finding.title: Shell command built from upload filename
finding.description: convert_upload runs subprocess.run with shell=True on a string that includes the uploaded filename. Reported again by the 2026-09 scan of the main branch.

issue.title: Shell command built from upload filename
issue.description: convert_upload runs subprocess.run with shell=True on a string that includes the uploaded filename.

comments.author: reviewer
comments.text: Fixed by passing an argument list to subprocess.run without shell=True; the filename is no longer interpolated.
